Diversity and Marketing. In July 2007, Intel ran an advertisement
(the “Sprinter Ad”) that generated quite a bit of controversy
and discussion, particularly in the blogosphere. Our ad, entitled
“Multiply Computing Performance and Maximize the Power of
Your Employees,” was intended to convey the performance
capabilities of our processors through the visual metaphor of
sprinters. We had used the visual of sprinters successfully in the
past, but in this case, the ad, using African American sprinters,
proved to be insensitive and insulting to many.
